import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # It contains two placeholders: {title} and {body}. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the headline and content safely escaped. """ # 1. Escape user input to neutralize special characters that could # be interpreted as HTML or script. This protects against CWE‑74. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # For the body we allow basic paragraph tags but still escape other # special characters. If richer formatting is required, a # dedicated sanitiser should be used. safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # 2. Insert the sanitized values into the predefined template. formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_body) return formatted
